info.title: 10MG Health Lending API
info.description:
Multi-tenant, white-label lending API for healthcare providers (pharmacies, clinics, hospitals, labs).

**Conventions**

- **Tenant:** authenticated tenant users act for their own institution (from the token). Public storefront endpoints and login take an `X-Tenant: <institution-slug>` header.
- **Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from `POST /v1/auth/login` or customer registration.
- **Money:** integers in minor units (kobo for NGN). **Rates:** basis points (`2400` = 24.00% p.a.).
- **Idempotency:** loan application, approval, rejection, cancellation, disbursement and repayment require an `Idempotency-Key` header. Retries with the same key replay the original response (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`).
- **Errors:** `{ "message": "...", "error": { "code": "MACHINE_CODE", "details": {} } }`.
- **Tracing:** every response carries `X-Request-Id`, which is also stored on audit entries.

post.description:
The BVN is matched with NIBSS and the NIN with NIMC. Both must match on name and date of
birth before the business can apply for a loan. A failed attempt is recorded and can be
retried with corrected details (422 `KYC_VERIFICATION_FAILED`). Requires an `Idempotency-Key`,
because every attempt is a billable provider lookup.
post.summary: Verify the business owner's BVN and NIN

post.description:
Staff record payments received; borrowers can pay their own loan (electronic channels only).
The amount is allocated oldest installment first (penalty → fees → interest → principal).
Overpayment is rejected and an `external_reference` can only be applied once.
Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header.
